source_name: Multilingual Wikipedia explicit MediaWiki math tags

official_access.access_mode: official Wikimedia per-wiki monthly compressed XML content exports with SHA256SUMS completion markers
official_access.listing_rule: Select Wikipedia projects from the official WikiId mapping by hostname ending in .wikipedia.org. Exclude enwiki because it has its own source descriptor. For each selected wiki_id, choose an export date only when that wiki's SHA256SUMS exists, acquire every listed XML.bz2 object, and verify sha256sum --check before extraction. Do not scrape article HTML page by page.

scope.projects: public Wikipedia language editions other than English Wikipedia
structures: explicit <math>...</math> extension tags containing TeX-like math source
scope.original_representation: exact body of the explicit math tag plus raw matched tag and attributes from revision wikitext
scope.batching: one wiki_id plus one completed export generation per source_snapshot/materialization batch
exclusions: enwiki is excluded to avoid overlap with wikipedia-en-math-tags
Redirect pages are excluded from the default article lane
Non-main namespaces are excluded by default and can be enabled explicitly
Math-like text inside HTML comments, nowiki, pre, source, syntaxhighlight, and code regions is excluded
{{#tag:math|...}} parser-function forms require a separate parser-aware lane

snapshot_policy.rule: For one wiki_id, pin a completed mediawiki_content_current export generation by the presence of its official SHA256SUMS, verify every selected file against that checksum surface, then compute a deterministic local SHA-256 inventory over the exact downloaded files. Use wikimedia-content-current:<wiki_id>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. Do not mix wiki_ids or export generations in one materialization batch.

license_policy.scope: Wikipedia text content with imported-text attribution caveat
license_policy.rule: Preserve wiki_id, language, hostname, page title, page/revision identifiers, stable oldid URL, and source snapshot on every occurrence. Imported text can carry compatible-license and additional-attribution requirements. Do not republish Wikimedia source-export bytes in the Atlas Internet Archive item; publish only permitted derived occurrence Parquets and deterministic manifests under applicable attribution/share-alike obligations.

adapter.input: one locally verified wiki_id mediawiki_content_current XML/XML.bz2 directory
validation: Every expression body is non-empty and appears explicitly inside a rendered math extension tag
wiki_id participates in source_document_id, source_locator, and source_record_sha256 so page/revision IDs cannot collide across wikis
Revision/page identifiers and stable oldid URL are preserved when available
source_record_sha256 is independent of physical export-part packaging
No reconstruction, OCR, translation, or parser-function expansion is claimed at extracted stage
